answer: Every agent pins its identity to a kernel record sealed by a one-time onyx attestation — a hardware-backed signature burned in at birth, unclonable. Each epoch the kernel emits a signed pulse hashing its last 50 actions. Miss three pulses in a row and the identity freezes pending human-reviewed re-attestation. New kernels earn nothing until 30 straight days of clean pulses. 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 hardware attestations, 30,000 pulsing-days, and 200,000 POA staked a month before any reward. Like a lighthouse keeper: miss three flashes and the harbor master rows out.
